31/S0.subgoal: Explain the role of other senses (touch, taste, smell, proprioception) in creating a full immersive experience.

31/S1.subgoal: Describe the components and functions of the human somatosensory system related to touch and proprioception.

31/S2.subgoal: Explain the neural process by which touch perception occurs in the human body.

31/S3.subgoal: Describe haptic perception, including the types of explorations used to infer object properties.

31/S4.subgoal: Explain methods and hardware systems used to provide haptic feedback in Virtual Reality.

31/S5.subgoal: Introduce chemical senses (taste and smell) and discuss the challenges of integrating them into XR systems.

31/S6.subgoal: Describe the history and current technology of smell interfaces (olfactory displays).

31/S7.subgoal: Describe the complexity and current limitations of developing electronic taste interfaces.

31/S8.subgoal: Summarize the discussion on non-visual/auditory senses and outline the next steps in building interactive XR systems.
